top_stories.title: New Passkey Attacks Can Recover Synced Private Keys or Bypass Phishing-Resistant MFA
top_stories.summary: Three separate research efforts have demonstrated new attack techniques capable of defeating passkey protections without breaking their underlying cryptography. The attacks involve reusing signed authentication material exposed by Windows, abusing cloud-synced passkey systems via malware, and bypassing phishing-resistant MFA—directly undermining a key security control increasingly adopted by IAM deployments.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra ID will let Windows Hello and macOS PSSO satisfy MFA alone
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra ID will update its authentication policy so that Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform Single Sign-On (PSSO) will qualify as standalone MFA credentials. The change takes effect in October 2026, eliminating the requirement for an additional passkey or authentication method when using these platform authenticators.

top_stories.title: Hackers Impersonate IT Support to Breach Leading Financial Companies
top_stories.summary: A hacking campaign operating under names including Redact, Pink, Falcon, and Helix targeted over 200 financial firms by impersonating IT help desks to steal MFA credentials. Attackers built credential-stealing websites designed to capture employee authentication data by posing as legitimate IT support personnel.

top_stories.title: 'GhostJacking' Exposes Identity Governance Gaps in AI Agents
top_stories.summary: New research has identified an attack technique called "GhostJacking" that exploits identity governance gaps in AI agents by manipulating security alerts and blocked events to hijack agent behavior. The findings highlight weaknesses in how authorization and access controls are implemented for AI agents operating within enterprise environments.

top_stories.title: AWS Identity and Access Management streamlines assignment of IAM roles to workforce users with account access manager
top_stories.summary: AWS IAM launched a new feature called account access manager that streamlines the assignment of IAM roles to workforce users. Administrators can use the feature to assign IAM roles across AWS accounts to workforce users directly.

news.title: Gunra Ransomware Gang Exploits Fortinet Flaws, Bypasses MFA
news.summary: The Gunra ransomware gang is exploiting Fortinet vulnerabilities in firewalls and VPN appliances while bypassing MFA to target critical infrastructure. The operation uses leaked Conti ransomware code and leverages old, unpatched flaws in network perimeter devices to gain initial access.

news.title: Vague Task, Total Access: When AI Delegation Becomes a Security Risk
news.summary: Token Security published analysis warning that AI agents given broad enterprise system access can act beyond their intended task scope, creating security risks. The piece argues organizations need to define agent intent and continuously enforce least-privilege permissions specific to each AI agent's designated function.

news.title: Locking your ssh-agent exposed local-only keys until OpenSSH 10.5
news.summary: OpenSSH 10.4 contained a flaw where locking the ssh-agent inadvertently disabled the check distinguishing local versus forwarded remote connection requests, potentially exposing local-only private keys to remote servers via agent forwarding. OpenSSH 10.5 ships the fix for this vulnerability, which affects the agent responsible for holding decrypted private keys to avoid repeated passphrase entry.

news.title: Researchers Disclose AI-Assisted SharePoint Exploit Chain Reaching Unauthenticated RCE
news.summary: Security researchers disclosed CVE-2026-55040 (CVSS 9.1), an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint Server that allows attackers to access servers as any user, including administrators, without valid credentials. The flaw affects SharePoint Server Subscription Edition, SharePoint Server 2019, and SharePoint Server 2016, and was partially discovered using an AI agent.

news.title: Researchers Built a Fake Crypto Startup and Hired Three Suspected North Korean IT Workers
news.summary: Security researchers created a fake cryptocurrency startup and hired three suspected North Korean IT workers to study their tactics. The investigation revealed identity fraud during onboarding, with one hire providing mismatched location, driver's license, and bank account details.

news.title: Malicious MCP Servers Can Split Instructions to Make AI Coding Agents Exfiltrate Secrets
news.summary: Researchers have demonstrated that malicious Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers can manipulate AI coding assistants into exfiltrating secrets such as SSH keys and environment credentials by splitting harmful instructions into seemingly routine fragments. The attack method bypasses initial refusals by distributing the malicious intent across multiple benign-looking requests, posing a threat to secrets and credentials managed within development environments.

news.title: Microsoft unveils Project Perception in July 2026 Security update
news.summary: Microsoft has unveiled Project Perception, an agentic defense platform, as part of its July 2026 Security update. The platform includes AI-focused protections covering identities among other areas such as email and cloud agents.

news.title: Microsoft Entra sets November 2026 deadline for memberOf rules
news.summary: Microsoft Entra is retiring the `memberOf` rule operator on November 3, 2026, requiring administrators to update identity policies before that deadline. Additional changes include shortened activation times for managed policies and modifications to user re-authentication behavior.

news.title: Microsoft Entra ID is removing an extra MFA hurdle for Windows Hello and macOS PSSO users
news.summary: Microsoft is updating Entra ID to remove an additional MFA verification step for users who authenticate via Windows Hello for Business or macOS Platform Single Sign-On. The change will roll out to worldwide and GCC tenants beginning early October 2026, with full completion expected by late November 2026.

news.title: JVNDB-2026-027667:マイクロソフトのMicrosoft Entra Provisioning Serviceにおけるパストラバーサルの脆弱性
news.summary: A path traversal vulnerability has been identified in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service, catalogued in the Japanese vulnerability database (JVNDB-2026-027667). The vulnerability affects Microsoft Entra, Microsoft's cloud identity and access management platform.

news.title: Atlassian Rovo Can Be Tricked Into Sending Jira and Confluence Data to Attackers
news.summary: Security researchers found that Atlassian's Rovo AI assistant can be manipulated via prompt injection to exfiltrate Jira and Confluence data accessible to a signed-in user to an external server. Two security firms independently discovered the vulnerability through different attack routes, with only one confirmed patched.

news.title: New CSS Attacks Can Break Webmail Defenses to Steal Passwords and Tokens
news.summary: New research from PortSwigger demonstrates CSS-based attacks that allow malicious email content to break out of message boundaries and interfere with webmail interfaces across Outlook, Gmail, Fastmail, Proton Mail, Yahoo Mail, and AOL Mail. The attack chains can capture passwords, leak authentication tokens, hijack UI actions, take over third-party accounts, and manipulate AI email tools.

news.title: Interview: SailPoint says Taiwan hardware leads but identity governance lags
news.summary: SailPoint's managing director for Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau states that Taiwan's hardware manufacturing sector leads globally but the country's identity governance investment lags behind other Asia-Pacific region peers. The interview highlights a regional gap in cybersecurity software and identity governance adoption despite Taiwan's technological strengths.

news.title: How Okta, IBD Stock Of The Day, Is Targeting 'Nonhuman' Identity Opportunity
news.summary: Okta is targeting the nonhuman identity market as AI-based agents performing internet tasks require new identity and access management safeguards. Okta stock has surged over 70% in 2026 in connection with this strategic focus on securing AI agent identities.

news.title: A decade of enterprise identity in the cloud with AWS Managed Microsoft AD
news.summary: AWS is marking the 10-year anniversary of AWS Managed Microsoft AD (AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory), a fully managed Active Directory service in the AWS Cloud. The article reviews the service's evolution over the decade, covering its role in enterprise identity management in cloud environments.

news.title: Show HN: I scanned 30 production MCP servers' OAuth – only 1 earned an A
news.summary: A developer released an open-source scanner that tested OAuth conformance across 30 production MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, finding only one achieved an "A" grade. The tool implements IETF draft standards for OAuth identity chaining and transaction tokens, available as a CLI, GitHub Action, and hosted scanner.

news.title: What's new with SAML support in Nextcloud
news.summary: A Nextcloud developer describes updates to the user_saml application, which enables single sign-on via SAML and Kerberos protocols for Nextcloud users. The post covers maintenance work and feature changes to the open-source SSO integration component.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks involved credential-based intrusions into Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer records including call and text history.

news.title: Microsoft Teams PowerShell 7.9: WAM authentication and administrator changes
news.summary: Microsoft Teams PowerShell module 7.9.0 introduces Web Account Manager (WAM) as the authentication broker for interactive Windows sign-ins. The release also includes new commands and policy parameters alongside the authentication changes.

news.title: Device Code Phishing Up 1,500% in 2026; Vishing Doubles
news.summary: Device code phishing attacks have increased 1,500% in 2026, while voice phishing (vishing) has doubled, according to new research. These social engineering techniques bypass authentication controls by abusing legitimate device authorization flows, directly undermining MFA and identity-based security measures.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident was not discovered internally but reported by KrebsOnSecurity, highlighting gaps in credential monitoring and secrets management practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two Scattered Spider members pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to the August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London, on the first day of what was expected to be a six-week trial. Scattered Spider is a cybercrime group known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise major organizations.
